blocks.text: Managing your Chrome environment on Mac

Support specialists often juggle multiple tabs for ticketing systems, internal knowledge bases, and CRM platforms. Keeping these organized prevents mistakes. Use ⌘ + 1 through ⌘ + 8 to switch between your first eight tabs instantly. If you need to jump to the last tab, use ⌘ + 9. This saves time when you are cross-referencing a customer ticket with a technical manual.
Using Chrome profiles for support workflows

If you share your Mac or just want to keep your work life separate, create dedicated Chrome profiles. Go to your profile icon in the top right corner and select Add. This keeps your work bookmarks, extensions, and cached passwords isolated from your personal browsing. It also prevents you from accidentally logging into a personal account when you need to be in your company's help desk software.
Speeding up ticket responses with dictation

Writing repetitive email responses drains your energy. Hold the fn key on your Mac to use Lazur for dictating your replies. Speak your response naturally. Lazur formats the text, allowing you to insert it directly into your ticketing system. This keeps your hands on the keyboard and helps you maintain a steady pace during high-volume periods.

Sometimes your help desk software will stop responding. Before you restart your entire browser, try clearing data for just that site. Click the lock icon in the address bar, select Site settings, and clear the data. This often fixes loading errors without forcing you to sign back into every other tab you have open.

blocks.text: Support specialists spend a lot of time on tasks that do not involve talking to customers. If you are stuck on a complex setting or need to find a specific menu item in a dense CRM interface, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur where it is. Lazur will draw a circle around the button or setting you need. This removes the guesswork from your daily routine.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons inside my ticketing system?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or operate other apps for you. It points at items on your screen to help you find them, but you must perform the actual click.

faq.question: What is the best way to manage multiple Chrome windows for different clients?
faq.answer: Use separate Chrome profiles for each client or project. You can switch between them using ⌘ + ` or by clicking your profile icon in the toolbar.

faq.question: Does Lazur store my screen content?
faq.answer: No. Lazur only looks at your screen while you hold the shortcut key. The data is sent to AI providers to answer your request and is not stored or used to train models.
